label: Content-fixed favouring laws, from the definitions
description: A placed diagnostic for 608a262d. It supplies the discriminating contrastive standard that SelectionScope's determination laws left open: the explanans is individuated independently of the outcome partition, and it is not met trivially, because an outcome-independent asymmetric content cannot select whatever outcome occurs (the #742 incompatible core on choice cells), while the re-description that meets the determination standard (law 8) does so only by being outcome-dependent. Good-bounded favouring explains no contrast between outcomes that the standard ties and selects nothing when every outcome is bettered, whoever the source. Establishes no premise.
